---
name: Feature Request
description: Suggest a new skill, agent, hook, or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Use Case
Explain the problem this solves or the workflow it enables. Who benefits?

## Proposed Solution
Describe your preferred implementation:
- New skill in `.hermes/skills/feature-name/`
- New agent in `.hermes/agents/feature-name.md`
- New hook in `.hermes/hooks/feature-name.py`
- New script in `.hermes/scripts/feature-name.sh`
- Quality gate rule addition
- Documentation update

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Free-Only Compliance
- [ ] Does not require paid API keys
- [ ] Works with NVIDIA/Groq/Pollinations free tiers
- [ ] No external paid dependencies

## Additional Context
Mockups, references to CCGS original, related issues, etc.

## Checklist
- [ ] Aligns with Collaborative Design Principle (User = Creative Director)
- [ ] Follows existing skill/agent/hook patterns
- [ ] Includes tests or validation approach
- [ ] Updates relevant documentation
